definitions.explanation: A person who attends school or university.

examples.japanese: {日本語|にほんご}の{学生|がくせい}です。
{学生|がくせい}の{時|とき}、よく{旅行|りょこう}しました。
examples.english: When I was a student, I traveled a lot.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{学生|がくせい}に{人気|にんき}があって、いつも{若|わか}い{人|ひと}でいっぱいです。
examples.english: This shop is popular with students, and is always full of young people.

examples.japanese: {外国|がいこく}から{来|き}た{学生|がくせい}と{友達|ともだち}になって、{毎週|まいしゅう}いっしょに{日本語|にほんご}を{勉強|べんきょう}しています。
examples.english: I became friends with a student from abroad, and we study Japanese together every week.

notes:
{学生|がくせい} means student, typically referring to someone attending school from elementary through university.

STUDENT TYPES BY LEVEL:
- {小学生|しょうがくせい}: elementary school student
- {中学生|ちゅうがくせい}: junior high school student
- {高校生|こうこうせい}: high school student
- {大学生|だいがくせい}: university student
- {留学生|りゅうがくせい}: international student

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {学生|がくせい}{時代|じだい}: student days
- {学生|がくせい}{証|しょう}: student ID
- {学生|がくせい}{割引|わりびき}: student discount

CONTRAST:
- {生徒|せいと}: pupil (more common for elementary/junior high)
- {児童|じどう}: child (formal, used in education contexts)
